sourceVisualNotes: Actual inventory board shows1719 a plain leaf-brow open gold helm; do not invent a giant scorpion creature.1765 is one crescent surrounding one blue star;1899 is wraparound red iridescent goggles;1972/1973 are distinct red/blue winged heart ornaments;2147 is a very small low pearl tiara with green/red central stones.

items.name: scorpion-cloud-helm
items.designBrief: Open golden helm with broad smooth leaf-shaped forehead peak, two outward swept horn fins and two curved long cheek guards, empty face gap. Restrained small segmented/scorpion-tail engraving on brow is our original detail, no face, no anime copy.

items.name: blue-star-moon-coronet
items.designBrief: A thick rounded warm-gold crescent with its opening facing left, a single luminous-material BLUE five-point crystal star inside the opening. Tiny jade cloud etching, clean simple silhouette; no external glow or background.

items.name: rainbow-jade-goggles
items.designBrief: One pair of curved wraparound protective goggles, broad contiguous red-violet iridescent lens with rainbow reflections, ivory/gold/jade carved rim and short visible side strap tabs. Contemporary goggle function in our hand-painted Daoist accessory style, no wearer.

items.name: red-heart-wing-coronet
items.designBrief: One red ruby heart ornament below a smaller matching red heart, with two full ivory feather wings spread left/right and thin gold-jade edging. Heart and wings are joined as one complete head ornament, no face or body.

items.name: blue-heart-wing-coronet
items.designBrief: Matching counterpart but clearly BLUE sapphire heart pair, ivory feather wings with jade-blue feather tips, delicate gold edging. Same family as red heart but independently drawn, no extra red heart, complete single accessory.

items.name: pearl-princess-tiara
items.designBrief: A distinctly LOW petite open pearl tiara, thin curved ivory-gold band, tiny side scrolls, central upright clear crystal with a red tip above green-red jewel accents, small pearl beads along brow. Delicate airy silhouette unlike tall helmets, no head.
